instruction: Cinematic film still, medium shot of a dimly lit hall with a stage background and a wall clock. On the left, the blonde man in a leather jacket (R1) poses with one hand on his hip and the other raised above his head, looking right. In the center, the dark-haired man in a white t-shirt and harness (R3) leans back with arms raised in a dance pose. On the right, the long-haired man in a mesh shirt (R2) stands with hand on hip, looking forward. The three dancers stand close together in a stylized group pose under cool blue ambient light with purple highlights.
